digest.component_or_area: completion verifier budget and verdict caching
propositions: Step budget exhausts prematurely on legitimate multi-criterion (epic) validation due to undersized floor and missing evidence-surface scaling term, causing valid criteria to fail as unmet when only unproven within budget.

Budget formula lacks per-child traversal cost; current story-calibrated model (8 steps/criterion, 48-step floor) does not account for child ticket enumeration (5-10 requests per child in epics), forcing false budget failures.
Every completion re-verification re-proves all criteria from scratch with no cross-run caching of validated PASS verdicts, causing repeated 10-minute cycles on retry/rebase workflows.
Runaway tool use is already separately guarded by tool_calls_limit and loop detection; a tight budget adds false FAILs without safety benefit.
A --ref-targeted verification must persist and reuse cached verdicts keyed by the ref's blob fingerprint, not HEAD's, to prevent seeding verdicts proven against a different tree.
